duration-fast.$description: Hover, press and color changes on controls (the spec's 120 to 150ms transitions).

duration-moderate.$description: Small movements: toggle thumbs, chevrons, tooltips appearing.

duration-slow.$description: Larger movements: drawers, dialogs, progress bars.

ease-standard.$description: Movement that starts and ends on screen.

ease-enter.$description: Things arriving: overlays opening, toasts sliding in.

ease-exit.$description: Things leaving: overlays closing, toasts dismissed.
